name: Level Lock+ Matter (US)

radios.note: Level lists Bluetooth 4.0/5.0 and Matter over Thread, running at the same time.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Level Lock+ (Matter)' from Assa Abloy with Thread and Bluetooth transports. There are several listings, one per firmware version (2024 to January 2026).

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread, with Apple Home Key. Needs a Thread border router acting as home hub, such as a HomePod mini or a Thread-capable Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a Nest Hub (2nd gen).

alexa.note: Matter over Thread; needs an Echo or other Alexa device that is a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Matter over Thread through a SmartThings hub that is a Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Level page says Level Matter devices work locally through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router. Forum users report commissioning problems with the Level Bolt.

hubRequired.note: The Level app controls the lock directly over Bluetooth. Matter platforms and away-from-home control need a Thread border router.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread stays on the local network.

lockFit.note: Level says the Lock+ replaces your existing lock and comes with its own house keys; the spec page lists a 1 3/4 in door, 2 1/8 in bore and 2 3/8 in backset. Do not confuse it with the Level Bolt, the retrofit model that keeps your current keys.

keypad.note: The Level Keypad is a separate accessory, sold on its own.

power.note: One CR2 lithium (non-rechargeable) battery hidden inside the bolt; Level gives up to a year of life in typical use.

summary: Apple Home Key works on the Level Lock+ (Matter), a deadbolt replacement that also joins Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant over Matter on Thread. It runs Bluetooth and Thread at the same time, so the Level app works without a border router while Matter platforms and away-from-home control need one. One CR2 battery gives up to a year in typical use. The keypad is a separate purchase.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini, Thread-capable Apple TV 4K, Nest Hub (2nd gen) or Thread-capable Echo.
It replaces your lock and comes with new keys; the Level Bolt is the retrofit model that keeps your current ones.
Check the door first: Level lists a 1 3/4 in door, 2 1/8 in bore and 2 3/8 in backset.
Home Assistant forum users report commissioning problems with the Level Bolt.
